title: Latvian diplomat gets important EU human rights job
summary_full: On 19th October 2026, the Council of the European Union (EU) appointed Ilze Brands-Kehris as the EU Special Representative for Human Rights, according to a release from the Latvian Foreign Ministry.
summary_public: On 19th October 2026, the Council of the European Union (EU) appointed Ilze Brands-Kehris as the EU Special Representative for Human Rights, according to a release from the Latvian Foreign Ministry.
